Vía Recreativa Metropolitana

Vía Recreativa car-free Sunday

Puebla, Mexico · La Paz to the Recta a Cholula · Open streets · Social

Family

Vía Recreativa Metropolitana is an open-streets program in Puebla, Mexico: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs every Sunday from 7:00 am local time. About 6.5 km (4 miles).

Next ride Sun, Oct 4, 7:00 AM CST

For visitors

Free. Basic repairs, first aid, toilets and water points for people and dogs along the route.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Vía Recreativa Metropolitana group ride

Puebla's Sunday car-free corridor from La Paz out to Cholula. An easy 6.5 km each way with repair and water points. Good for a morning spin, or to reach Cholula without traffic.
